day5_school_arrive.name: Me
day5_school_arrive.text: *I walk through the school gate. The school is quiet on a Sunday.*

day5_school_arrive2.name: Me
day5_school_arrive2.text: *This week went by so fast. I can't believe it's already the last day... The trees in the schoolyard sway gently in the breeze.*

day5_school_arrive3.name: Me
day5_school_arrive3.text: *It was only a few days ago, but it feels like ages. I was so nervous and anxious back then. Look how much has changed now.*

day5_school_arrive4.name: Me
day5_school_arrive4.text: *Looking back, someone is walking from afar. A familiar figure.*

day5_meet_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_meet_seoyeon.text: "This is where we first met, right? You looked like a lost puppy back then, hehe."

day5_meet_seoyeon2.name: Seoyeon
day5_meet_seoyeon2.text: "But now... you seem different. There's a sense of ease about you. It's a nice change."

day5_react_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_react_seoyeon.text: *Seeing Seoyeon's smiling face makes my heart feel warm. She was the first person to reach out to me at this school.*

day5_seoyeon_d4_warmth.name: Seoyeon
day5_seoyeon_d4_warmth.text: "...You know, when you hugged me last night... I was really grateful. It gave me courage."

day5_seoyeon_d4_warmth_pinky.name: Seoyeon
day5_seoyeon_d4_warmth_pinky.text: "The pinky promise from last night... my fingertip still feels warm. Please keep your promise, okay?"

day5_meet_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_meet_yuna.text: "...Here. Do you remember when we first met? ...I do."

day5_meet_yuna2.name: Yuna
day5_meet_yuna2.text: "...When you were standing at the gate, you looked lonely. ...I was the same way, so I could tell."

day5_react_yuna.name: Me
day5_react_yuna.text: *This is the first time Yuna has said so much. Does that mean today is a special day for her too?*

day5_yuna_d4_warmth.name: Yuna
day5_yuna_d4_warmth.text: "...Thank you for holding my hand last night. ...It was warm."

day5_yuna_d4_warmth_ally.name: Yuna
day5_yuna_d4_warmth_ally.text: "...For taking my side yesterday. ...I won't forget it."

day5_meet_dain.name: Dain
day5_meet_dain.text: "Hey! Being at the school gate reminds me of the first day!! Do you remember when I hit you with the volleyball?!"

day5_meet_dain2.name: Dain
day5_meet_dain2.text: "I felt so bad about it, but looking back, maybe it was fate! If I hadn't hit you, I never would've talked to you!!"

day5_react_dain.name: Me
day5_react_dain.text: *Getting hit by that volleyball did hurt... but if it's how I met Dain, maybe I should be grateful.*

day5_dain_d4_warmth.name: Dain
day5_dain_d4_warmth.text: "...Me crying yesterday is a SECRET!! But... I'm glad I could cry in front of you."

day5_meet_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_meet_nurse.text: "Coming to school on a weekend feels strange. Meeting you at this school... was it destiny, I wonder."

day5_meet_nurse2.name: School Nurse
day5_meet_nurse2.text: "When you came to the nurse's office on your first day, your nervous face was so cute. You've matured a lot since then."

day5_react_nurse.name: Me
day5_react_nurse.text: *Seeing her in casual clothes feels unfamiliar yet exciting. I had no idea she looked this beautiful underneath that usual lab coat.*

day5_meet_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_meet_teacher.text: "Ha, coming to school on a weekend is weird. But... being here with you, it's not so bad."

day5_meet_teacher2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_meet_teacher2.text: "When I first saw you in the staff room on your transfer day, your eyes looked so anxious. Now you seem like a completely different person."

day5_react_teacher.name: Me
day5_react_teacher.text: *Getting a compliment from her is so rare that it makes me even happier. She has such a soft expression today too.*

day5_outfit_compliment.name: Me
day5_outfit_compliment.text: (They look me up and down, eyes widening. "Why do you look so nice today?" The small compliment makes my heart flutter.)

day5_walk_together.name: Me
day5_walk_together.text: "Want to go inside? There are a lot of places with memories here."

day5_walk_enter.name: Me
day5_walk_enter.text: *We walked into the school side by side. The school is empty on a Sunday, so only our footsteps echo through the halls.*

day5_corridor1.name: Me
day5_corridor1.text: *This hallway... On my first day as a transfer student, I wandered here trying to find my classroom. I couldn't bring myself to move, not knowing where to go.*

day5_corridor2.name: Me
day5_corridor2.text: *Someone spoke to me in this hallway back then. That small act of kindness led to everything that followed.*

day5_classroom_enter.name: Me
day5_classroom_enter.text: *I opened the classroom door. Sunlight streams in at an angle, painting the desks in a golden glow.*

day5_classroom1.name: Me
day5_classroom1.text: *My seat. The same seat I first sat in when I transferred here is still here. I sat down in it for a moment.*

day5_classroom2.name: Me
day5_classroom2.text: *Looking up at the blackboard from this seat... Ah, it's the same angle as back then. Somehow, it feels comforting.*

day5_classroom3.name: Me
day5_classroom3.text: "A lot happened in this classroom. Getting caught dozing off during class, passing notes around..."

day5_classroom_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_classroom_seoyeon.text: "Yeah. When you first introduced yourself, I already thought 'This person seems nice.' Call it the student council president's intuition."

day5_classroom_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_classroom_yuna.text: "...Our eyes met here for the first time. I was looking out the window... and when you looked at me, my heart skipped a beat."

day5_classroom_dain.name: Dain
day5_classroom_dain.text: "We used to stretch in here before gym class!! You were so inflexible back then, lol. Has it gotten any better?"

day5_classroom_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_classroom_nurse.text: "When I came for a class observation, I noticed you kept looking toward the nurse's office window, you know? Hehe."

day5_classroom_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_classroom_teacher.text: "Every day in this classroom, I called your name during roll call. Just when I was getting used to it... it's already the end."

day5_memory_spot_suggest.name: Me
day5_memory_spot_suggest.text: "Is there anywhere you'd like to go? Let's look around some more."

day5_memory_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_memory_seoyeon.text: "Oh! Wait, let's go to the garden. Remember the flower bed I used to water every day?"

day5_memory_seoyeon2.name: Seoyeon
day5_memory_seoyeon2.text: "Look, all the flowers I planted have bloomed. You helped me water them the first time you came here. That's when I... started to feel something."

day5_memory_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_memory_yuna.text: "...Wait. Can we go over there? The library."

day5_memory_yuna2.name: Yuna
day5_memory_yuna2.text: "...This is where you first sat next to me. When you asked me about the book title... I was surprised. Nobody had ever talked to me before."

day5_memory_dain.name: Dain
day5_memory_dain.text: "Wait!! Let's go to the gym!! That's where the whole thing started on the first day!!"

day5_memory_dain2.name: Dain
day5_memory_dain2.text: "I was practicing volleyball here and the ball went flying... and hit you right in the face! Sorry, haha! But I was grateful you didn't get mad."

day5_memory_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_memory_nurse.text: "Shall we stop by the nurse's office? I vividly remember the day you first came."

day5_memory_nurse2.name: School Nurse
day5_memory_nurse2.text: "On your first day, you came in saying you had a headache because you were so nervous. When I put my hand on your forehead... your face turned bright red, hehe."

day5_memory_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_memory_teacher.text: "Wait. Stand in front of the podium. That's where you introduced yourself on your first day."

day5_memory_teacher2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_memory_teacher2.text: "Your voice was trembling so much back then... I was thinking to myself, 'This kid, I'm a bit worried about him.' But you've really changed since then."

day5_memory_common.name: Me
day5_memory_common.text: *Memories of this place well up from deep within my heart. I knew nothing at first, but each passing day built up to who I am now.*

day5_memory_common2.name: Me
day5_memory_common2.text: *Every place holds a memory, and in every memory, this person was always there. I know what that means now.*

day5_rooftop_suggest.name: Me
day5_rooftop_suggest.text: "Hey... want to go up to the rooftop? The weather's nice today, and the view from up there should be great."

day5_rooftop_stairs1.name: Me
day5_rooftop_stairs1.text: *We climb the stairs. Two sets of footsteps echo through the empty stairwell. One floor, two floors.*

day5_rooftop_stairs2.name: Me
day5_rooftop_stairs2.text: *We reached the top of the last staircase and stood before the rooftop door. A breeze slips through the gap in the door.*

day5_rooftop_door.name: Me
day5_rooftop_door.text: *Creak. The rooftop door swings open to reveal a wide-open sky. A pleasant breeze greets us.*

day5_rooftop_view1.name: Me
day5_rooftop_view1.text: *Wow... Was the view from up here always this beautiful? The school grounds, the rooftops stretching into the distance, the streets we walked earlier.*

day5_rooftop_view2.name: Me
day5_rooftop_view2.text: *Or maybe... it feels this beautiful because of the person standing beside me.*

day5_rooftop_lean.name: Me
day5_rooftop_lean.text: *We leaned against the railing side by side. The wind tousles our hair.*

day5_rooftop_silence.name: Me
day5_rooftop_silence.text: *For a while, we just gazed at the scenery in silence. Strangely, the silence doesn't feel awkward. With this person, words aren't always necessary.*

day5_rooftop_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_rooftop_seoyeon.text: "I have a dream. Even after graduating from this school, I want to be someone who works for others. Being on the student council made me think about that even more."

day5_rooftop_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_rooftop_yuna.text: "...I want to write. I can say things in writing that I can't say to people. ...I'd like it if you read what I write."

day5_rooftop_dain.name: Dain
day5_rooftop_dain.text: "You know what, I want to become a pro athlete! Compete in nationals, win the championship, be on TV! ...But sometimes I get scared. Like, can I really do it?"

day5_rooftop_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_rooftop_nurse.text: "At first, I wanted to be a hospital nurse. But after taking care of the kids at school, I felt like this is where I belong. ...And this is where I met you, too."

day5_rooftop_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_rooftop_teacher.text: "When I first became a teacher, I had no confidence. But meeting students like you... honestly, it makes me feel like I made the right choice."

day5_rooftop_future_talk.name: Me
day5_rooftop_future_talk.text: "Me too... honestly, before I transferred here, I didn't have the luxury to think about the future. It felt like I was just getting through each day."

day5_rooftop_feeling1.name: Me
day5_rooftop_feeling1.text: "But things changed after I came here. I started looking forward to tomorrow. Meeting people became fun... and coming to school every day made me happy."

day5_rooftop_feeling2.name: Me
day5_rooftop_feeling2.text: *That's all... because of the person beside me. I can't put it all into words just yet, but someday, I will.*

day5_lunch_suggest.name: Me
day5_lunch_suggest.text: "Are you hungry? I picked some things up from the convenience store earlier. Want to eat up here?"

day5_lunch_setup.name: Me
day5_lunch_setup.text: *I pulled out some rice balls and drinks from my bag. It's a simple meal, but with this view, anything would feel special.*

day5_lunch_sit.name: Me
day5_lunch_sit.text: *We sat down side by side against the shaded wall near the railing. The concrete floor is a bit cold, but the warmth beside me makes up for it.*

day5_lunch_eat1.name: Me
day5_lunch_eat1.text: *I took a bite of the rice ball. It's just a simple convenience store rice ball, but today it tastes especially good.*

day5_lunch_talk1.name: Me
day5_lunch_talk1.text: "You know, eating up here on the rooftop feels like we're on a picnic."

day5_lunch_talk2.name: Me
day5_lunch_talk2.text: *I heard a soft laugh from beside me. That laughter drifted away on the breeze, carried off somewhere far.*

day5_lunch_talk3.name: Me
day5_lunch_talk3.text: "Before I transferred here, eating alone was just normal for me. In the classroom, at home. I thought I was fine with it."

day5_lunch_talk4.name: Me
day5_lunch_talk4.text: "But now... I realize for the first time how nice it is to eat with someone."

day5_lunch_moment_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_lunch_moment_seoyeon.text: "Same here. I was always so busy with student council work that I just ate alone. But eating with you... it feels like time slows down."

day5_lunch_touch_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_seoyeon.text: *Seoyeon gently rested her head on my shoulder. Her cheeks flushed red. I feel like my heart is going to stop.*

day5_lunch_moment_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_lunch_moment_yuna.text: "...Me too. I thought eating alone was comfortable... but when I'm next to you, the food tastes better."

day5_lunch_touch_yuna.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_yuna.text: *Yuna's hand quietly slid over mine. Her cold fingertips slowly grew warmer. I held her hand in mine.*

day5_lunch_moment_dain.name: Dain
day5_lunch_moment_dain.text: "When I eat alone, I always eat super fast! But when I'm with you, I eat slowly. Isn't that weird...?"

day5_lunch_touch_dain.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_dain.text: (Dain suddenly grabbed my arm tightly. "Hey, don't go all quiet on me, it makes me worry!" she said, but she didn't let go.)

day5_lunch_moment_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_lunch_moment_nurse.text: "As you grow up, moments like these become fewer and fewer. That's why... this moment right now is all the more precious."

day5_lunch_touch_nurse.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_nurse.text: (She pressed the drink can gently against my cheek. "Cold, isn't it?" she said with a smile brighter than the sunlight.)

day5_lunch_moment_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_lunch_moment_teacher.text: "This is my first time eating with a student like this. As a teacher, it's a bit... but today, I just want to be here as a person."

day5_lunch_touch_teacher.name: Me
day5_lunch_touch_teacher.text: *She smiled and gently brushed her hand over my hair. Her usual strictness was nowhere to be found—only a warm, tender touch remained.*

day5_lunch_after.name: Me
day5_lunch_after.text: *I finished the last of my drink. The cold can had already turned lukewarm in my hands. Time passed so quickly.*

day5_lunch_cleanup.name: Me
day5_lunch_cleanup.text: *I gathered the trash and tidied up. On the rooftop floor, a sunlit imprint remained where we had been sitting.*

day5_pre_afternoon1.name: Me
day5_pre_afternoon1.text: *The sun has begun to pass its peak. The shadows are shorter than before.*

day5_pre_afternoon2.name: Me
day5_pre_afternoon2.text: *There's still time left today. No... more precisely, there are still words left unsaid.*

day5_pre_afternoon3.name: Me
day5_pre_afternoon3.text: *Something stirs deep inside my chest. This is a sign... that the time to gather my courage is approaching.*

day5_pre_afternoon4.name: Me
day5_pre_afternoon4.text: *To the person standing beside me. Today, there are feelings I absolutely must convey.*
